answer: The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in ripple, expire in ferrous, and basalt lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 71 aliases as a result needs 65 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4790 identities would post 1420 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
